0x000990.en: 「With what I've got now...@ this is as far as I go...!」

0x000A01.en: 「Ngh! So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000A89.en: 「Damn it!@ You won't get me next time!」

0x000B32.en: 「Tch!! What a short show that was!」

0x000BB2.en: 「Is this as far as I get...!?」

0x000CEE.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@ Not funny...」

0x000D42.en: 「I blew it...!@ Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000E93.en: 「This is as far as I go... The rest is up to you.」

0x000F01.en: 「Nngh! So they got the jump on me...」

0x000F3F.en: 「No good, we've taken too much damage... Falling back!」

0x000F8C.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000FCA.en: 「Kyaa! I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x001011.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x0010BC.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the one who becomes a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0011B4.en: 「Aw, shucks, they done got me good!」

0x0011F8.en: 「U-ungh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x001265.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0012AC.en: 「I'm sorry, the rest is up to you.」

0x0012E1.en: 「Damn! So this is the limit of my power...!」

0x0013CD.en: 「To be taken down in a place like this...@　I'm still green...!」

0x00141B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001494.en: 「Sorry!@　I'm pulling out of this one...!」

0x0014D6.en: 「Sorry, the rest is up to you!」

0x001505.en: 「Ah, no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x001543.en: 「Good grief, so this is where it ends.」

0x001572.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll take my leave.」

0x0015FD.en: 「Careless of me...@　I'll pull back for now...!」

0x001763.en: 「Ejecting...@　Ngh...! Not a graceful exit, is it...」

0x001821.en: 「Guaah! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0019F1.en: 「A-all hands!@　Abandoning ship is top priority...!!」

0x001B0F.en: 「Word came from President Hendricks that@　the summons to testify cannot be avoided.」

0x001B83.en: 「It seems he can't hold the congress back much@　longer... How shall we proceed?」

0x001C13.en: 「Hmph, dancing to a fabricated video...@　But the congress no longer matters.@　Find a suitable pretext and put it on hold.」

0x001CBE.en: 「Understood.@　Also, a reply came from 'Grey.'@　They're already on the move, it seems.」

0x001D61.en: 「Thanks to Commander Alteur going there in@ person, we captured a record of Zezernan's@ conspiracy being exposed...」

0x001E06.en: 「Seeing that footage, they'll rush here at once@　to verify whether it's true.」

0x001EC0.en: 「My predecessor was suspected, yes.@　Thought to be one of those pitiful wanderers...」

0x001F65.en: 「I was one of them, after all.@　Which is why I'm grateful to you, Lord Alteur.」

0x001FE9.en: 「I owe him something, yes.@　He was the one who saved my life, after all.」

0x002057.en: 「But I was only used as a tool...@　Though thanks to that, I gained a@　pipeline to 'Grey.'」

0x002108.en: 「And now that Lord Zezernan's plot is exposed,@ there should be no need for us to intervene.」

0x00218B.en: 「Indeed.@　The rest depends on Baral, Ruina, and the@　Steel Dragon Squadron.」

0x0021E1.en: 「Marshal Gaspard Gillan withdrawing the@　arrest order on them... does that mean he@　intends to bare his fangs at us in time?」

0x00228F.en: 「He'll use the Steel Dragon Squadron to keep@　us in check... but he won't send Federation@　forces directly against us.」

0x002318.en: 「That man intends to use the Gaia Sabers for@ all they're worth. Otherwise he'd have shown@ fierce resistance before they were even formed...」

0x0023D2.en: 「He won't let us look good in the first clash@ with the Guests. He'd also have caught the Steel@ Dragons long ago and handed them to us.」

0x002498.en: 「Any proper soldier would do just that.」

0x0024CF.en: 「Guarding his own position, using the Gaia@ Sabers, letting the Steel Dragons run loose as@ a check against us...」

0x00256A.en: 「Because he's a gifted strategist,@　he moves exactly as I intend.@　The rest is a matter of timing.」

0x002667.en: 「It's for my plan with Alteur. Obey.」

0x0026A1.en: 「Why do you side with that man so much?」

0x0026E7.en: 「I told you before... it's for a greater purpose.」

0x00273A.en: 「I nearly lost everything at <Earth Cradle>,@　even my life. But meeting Alteur showed me@　the stairway to even greater heights.」

0x0027ED.en: 「My plan is reaching new heights with his power.@ That's how I was able to save you... you, who@ were falling apart because of Mitarl's blunder.」

0x0028B6.en: 「So it's all thanks to Alteur, is it.@　But the one I hate most... is him.」

0x002939.en: 「Why did that degraded copy develop self-awareness and@ run away? Why did he stop us when we chased him?」

0x0029C2.en: 「And why... does he have power that I, the@　Originator, don't?」

0x002A3C.en: 「To find that reason as well, obey my order.」

0x002A85.en: （Don't you actually already know...?@　Isn't this something Papa and Alteur@　arranged together...?）

0x002B35.en: 「...Come to think of it, where's Lune?@　Didn't she want to come along with us?」

0x002BA6.en: 「She's back home minding the place with Xenia@　and Presia. Threw a huge fit about it, though.」

0x002C23.en: 「Bet Zashford's making his big move on her@　right about now.」

0x002D13.en: 「Carla gave me a tour of the underground@　secret base. So many big gimmicks in there,@　it really surprised me.」

0x002DA9.en: 「Right, right, it was just like a BF Base.」

0x002DE0.en: 「Docks built out by widening the island's@　underground cavern, hidden catapults, a launch@　elevator for the super robots...」

0x002E7F.en: 「What else, palm trees toppling over, or the@　pool sliding away?」

0x002EE4.en: 「And a rocket coming out of a building... yeah,@　there wasn't anything like that.」

0x002F52.en: 「I did get to see the disguised runway gimmick.@　A transport plane was just landing.」

0x002FCC.en: 「A transport?@　Did the parts for the Double EX arrive?」

0x003013.en: 「No, I heard it was supply cargo...」

0x00304A.en: 「Still, when did a base like this even get built...」

0x00308D.en: 「Turns out it was originally a <DC> secret base@　built on Dr. Bian Zoldark's orders.」

0x003106.en: 「Construction was halted after the <DC War>,@　but Ratsel and the others took it over,@　refitted it, and finished it up.」

0x0031D6.en: 「...So, what did you want to talk about?」

0x003201.en: 「Um... that supply cargo that just arrived...@　could it possibly be something my father@　arranged?」

0x0032C5.en: 「The supplies issued for the women had the@　cosmetics and aroma oil I always use, plus my@　supplements...」

0x00335E.en: 「They're rare items, so... you'd have to know@　my tastes to include them...」

0x00340D.en: 「...By the way, Ensign. I hear you're@　returning to the front lines?」

0x003466.en: 「Yes.@　They fixed up the remaining TE Absorber so I@　can pilot it on my own.」

0x0034DB.en: 「Given the situation, I can't stay shut away@　forever. I want to fight, carrying on Ensign@　Hugo's will.」

0x003583.en: （And... to confirm the true intentions of@　that person... of Professor Mitte...）

0x0035DC.en: 「...Understood.@　But you must survive, no matter what.」

0x00363E.en: 「There are others besides us who worry about you,@　you know...」

0x0036C0.en: 「A moment ago, the <Tronium>@　was installed in the Ashe.」

0x003759.en: 「We have an excellent staff.@　It's only to be expected.」

0x0037C2.en: 「...Now then, I must go help with the@　Jinrai's refit. Excuse me.」

0x003867.en: 「He's been quite cooperative.@　I'd thought he only cared about his own work.」

0x003925.en: 「Ah, no. Let's get back to it.@　The black hole engine and parts for the Mk-X@　should arrive here shortly, but...」

0x0039DC.en: 「First I want to collect operating data@　from the Tronium Engine.@　And get Ing used to the machine, too.」

0x00410A.en: 「Yes.@　Engine output gauge and parameters,@　putting them on the monitor.」

0x004841.en: 「The risk of overheat and runaway climbs,@　and it strains the machine badly. Be careful.」

0x004942.en: 「If the pilot's link level is high, not only does@　the output stabilize, it can actually be pushed@　even higher. That's another trait.」

0x0049E7.en: 「Right. When Ryusei's, Aya's, or Mai's@ psychodriver power surges, SRX outputs more@ than Overdrive. A double-edged sword, though.」

0x004AAD.en: 「So the T-LINK System and Tronium Engine@　have a synergy?」

0x004B21.en: 「There are cases, my own experience included, but...@　the details still aren't well understood.」

0x004BAD.en: 「One theory says <Tronium> might have@　a psychic responsiveness to it...」

0x004C1B.en: 「Mayday, mayday, mayday!@　This is T303! We're under attack by unknowns!@　Requesting rescue! Our position is...」

0x004CD0.en: 「!@　Raul, we've received an@　emergency call!」

0x00636C.en: 「Ing's mine to handle.@　The rest of you, finish off the others.」

0x006E51.en: （Is that the power hidden in Ing? If so,@　it's not as much as I was told.）

0x00B5E5.en: 「Yes... I'll follow you anywhere, Lord Alteur.」

0x00B66B.en: 「But Papa got the result he wanted, didn't he?」

0x00B6BE.en: 「No... I'll obey your orders.@　Because your wish... is my wish too, Papa.」

0x00B75A.en: (Cross him carelessly and I could get 'adjusted'...@ that won't do. I'll play the good boy for a while.)

0x00B7CE.en: （And then I'll kill Ing for certain... by my own hand.）
